blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Securitize operates VBILL with permissioned token transfers restricted to KYC-onboarded institutional holders and retains transfer-agent freeze and burn authority on behalf of Van Eck Associates.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VBILL has issuer-native minting surfaces on Ethereum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Solana, and every reviewed route is native issuance. Securitize and VanEck announced Wormhole as VBILL's official interoperability provider, but no VBILL-specific Wormhole deployment is observable: VBILL is absent from Wormholescan's Native Token Transfer registry, and a real redemption burn on Ethereum emits only the token's own Burn and Transfer events with no Wormhole LogMessagePublished, which an NTT burn would necessarily publish in the same transaction. Solana issuance likewise invokes only the Securitize DS program stack with no Wormhole program present. Cross-chain movement is therefore off-chain transfer-agent re-issuance against independent per-chain supplies, not a conserved bridge float, so no bridge control carries the claim.
